state:
Goal `core-time-and-1-more`: `Core\Time::at`, `fromEpoch` and `fromIso` have all their feature proofs — `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench with a recorded figure, a Rust test with its `covers:` marker and a `.nvst` case — and `Core\Time` has its class card (`TIME_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`).
`fromEpoch` and `fromIso` both threw jiff's own sentence for a time past the timestamp range. Each now throws a plain sentence naming the range: `fromEpoch` in seconds (`RuntimeError`), `fromIso` in the same `-9999-01-02T01:59:59Z..=9999-12-30T22:00:00Z` sentence `at` uses (`ParseError`, like every other `fromIso` refusal). A `fromIso` text that is not written as a timestamp still gets jiff's sentence, on purpose (the member's doc comment says why).
`Core\Time::parse` and `Core\Time::sleep` are untaken, and live in the same file.

next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` (the `TIME` row, its cards and `mod tests`), plus each member's own proof directories.

items.text: **`Core\Time::parse`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2163`, card `TIME_PARSE_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2306`, body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4403`. Its `$format` is a `Qual::Sink` CLDR pattern, so the attack should give it a hostile pattern (very long, every field letter, unbalanced quotes) as well as a text past the range; check that a range failure is a plain sentence, the way `at`, `fromEpoch` and `fromIso` now are. `built_from_iso` in `mod tests` is the shape for a Rust test that passes a string argument.

**`Core\Time::sleep`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests. Card `TIME_SLEEP_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2245`, body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:3553`. A bench of a member whose whole job is waiting measures the clock, not the member: decide between a bench of `sleep(0s)` and a `data/proofs/policy.json` skip with its reason, and say which in the commit.

backlog: `Core\Time\Date::minus`, `with`, `compareTo` and the `Core\Time\Date` class card (`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283`) — the goal's second class, after the `Core\Time` entry points.

`fromIso` accepts an offset up to `±25:59`, which is jiff's bound; RFC 3339 allows only `±23:59`. The card says RFC 3339. Not a safety problem; owner is the `Core\Time` module doc if anybody tightens it.
